name: Haus Mangweth
beschreibung: The Haus Mangweth welcomes travellers to a sunny, quiet setting in Nauders on the Reschen Pass, right where Austria, Italy, and Switzerland meet. Furnished in a classic Tyrolean country style, the guest rooms feature modern en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, and balconies showcasing unobstructed views of the Nauders fortress and majestic three-thousand-metre peaks. A wholesome breakfast featuring local products sets guests up for outdoor adventures in the alpine landscape. Hiking trails and scenic mountain biking tracks start right by the house, while in winter, the complimentary ski bus provides rapid access to the snow-sure ski area of Nauders Bergkastel.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine guesthouse in Nauders near the Reschen Pass with comfortable rooms and views across the border triangle.
